title: Q-QNFO-WATCH: QNFO-side monitor that Ultrastable deploys code unattended
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every QNFO fleet run
**Done check:** grep:instances/qnfo/ultrastable_watch.py::def check
**Status:** open

From the QNFO fleet (independent of Ultrastable's tick) read releases, changelog, merged-PR and deploy counts and /live; pass or fail against a threshold (at least N merged PRs and one deploy in 24h); show on the QNFO dashboard; open an item in Ultrastable's queue on a miss. Deploy count, releases and changelog are first-class metrics on both sides. Filed at thread close; the executor works it in driver order.
